capabilities: Render desmos-graph code blocks as interactive Desmos calculators in Reading view and Live Preview
Pan, zoom, and drive graphs with generated slider controls
Save viewport bounds and slider values back into the block text
Download and cache the Desmos API calculator.js using a personal API key
Auto-label curves with typeset labels in the curve's colour
extras: Desktop-only (isDesktopOn true, no mobile support). Requires a free Desmos Personal Project API key; the API file is downloaded from desmos.com because its terms forbid bundling. Not yet in the community directory, so BRAT or manual install is described. Grammar is ported from Nigecat/obsidian-desmos under GPL-3.0; the code was written with Anthropic's Claude. No 3D calculator support.
intentEvidence: The grammar is a strict superset of obsidian-desmos 0.6.8, so notes written for that plugin render unchanged.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to turn desmos-graph code blocks into a live graphing calculator inside a note, and existing rendering plugins cannot be swapped without conflicts.

relations.evidence: If you are coming from obsidian-desmos, disable it first — only one plugin can render a given code fence
it downloads Desmos's calculator.js from desmos.com with your API key

requires.name: desmos.com sign-in to obtain a key

summary: Renders desmos-graph code blocks as interactive, pan-and-zoom Desmos calculators with sliders, and writes the saved view back into the block.
